metadata.repo_type_justification: VB.NET source code with Page_Load entry point and web.config for IIS deployment. Single deployable ASP.NET WebForms application.
metadata.archetype_justification: SQL Server database with CRUD operations (SELECT, INSERT) on employee-specific timesheet records. User-specific data with entity lifecycle management.

findings.title: No Programmatic API — WebForms UI Only
findings.description: The application is an ASP.NET WebForms app using HTML postbacks and server-side ViewState. No REST, GraphQL, or AsyncAPI interface exists. Integration requires UI automation or direct database access.
findings.gap: No programmatic API exists. The only interaction surface is the browser-rendered WebForms UI.
findings.recommendation: Create a REST API layer (ASP.NET Web API or minimal API) exposing timesheet CRUD operations as HTTP endpoints with JSON payloads.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Create a REST API layer exposing timesheet CRUD operations.
blocker_remediation.target_state: Documented REST API with OpenAPI specification.

findings.title: No Machine-Readable API Specification
findings.description: No OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL schema, or machine-readable specification exists.
findings.gap: No machine-readable spec for agent tool generation.
findings.recommendation: Create OpenAPI 3.0 spec alongside API layer build-out using code-first annotations.

findings.title: Unstructured Error Responses
findings.description: Application returns unstructured ASP.NET error pages with customErrors mode='Off'. No structured error codes or machine-readable error bodies.
findings.gap: Agents cannot distinguish retriable from terminal errors.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured JSON error responses with error code, message, and retryable boolean.

findings.title: Non-Idempotent Write Operations
findings.description: The btnSave_Click handler performs INSERT without idempotency key, unique constraint, or deduplication. Repeated submissions create duplicate records.
findings.gap: No idempotency mechanism. Duplicate timesheet entries created on retry.
findings.recommendation: Add unique constraint on (employee_id, entry_date, project) and implement idempotency key support.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no idempotency mechanism exists.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Write-enabled agents retry on failure. Non-idempotent INSERT creates duplicate timesheet records on retry.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Add unique constraint and idempotency key support.
blocker_remediation.target_state: Write operations are idempotent — duplicates return existing record.

findings.title: HTML/ViewState Response Format
findings.description: Application returns HTML with ViewState. Multi-megabyte pages not suitable for machine consumption.
findings.gap: No JSON or structured response format for agent consumption.
findings.recommendation: Use JSON response format when building API layer.

findings.title: No Event Emission for State Changes
findings.description: No event emission capability. No webhooks, SNS, EventBridge, or messaging infrastructure.
findings.gap: State changes produce no downstream notifications.
findings.recommendation: Implement event emission (SNS or EventBridge) for timesheet state changes.

findings.title: No Rate Limit Documentation or Headers
findings.description: No rate limits documented and no rate limit headers returned.
findings.gap: Agents have no self-throttling signal.
findings.recommendation: Implement X-RateLimit-Remaining and Retry-After headers when building API layer.

findings.title: No Machine Identity Authentication
findings.description: Only Forms Authentication (browser-based login). No OAuth2 client credentials, API keys, or mTLS for machine identity.
findings.gap: Agents cannot authenticate without simulating human browser sessions.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth2 client credentials flow or API key authentication with principal attribution.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Implement OAuth2 client credentials or API key authentication.
blocker_remediation.target_state: Service accounts authenticate programmatically with unique principal attribution.

findings.title: No Scoped Permissions Model
findings.description: Single database user (ts_app) with full access. No role differentiation or scoped permissions.
findings.gap: Cannot create scoped permissions for agent identities.
findings.recommendation: Implement RBAC with at minimum read-only and read-write roles.

compensating_controls: Implement read-only database user for queries
Add API-layer authorization middleware

findings.title: No Action-Level Authorization
findings.description: No action-level authorization. All authenticated users can read and write without restriction.
findings.gap: Cannot restrict agent to read-only within same resource type.
findings.recommendation: Implement action-level permission checks (canRead, canWrite) in middleware.

compensating_controls: Implement middleware checking caller role before write operations
Use API Gateway method-level authorization

findings.title: No Identity Propagation
findings.description: Session-based identity (InProc). No JWT, token exchange, or on-behalf-of flows.
findings.gap: Cannot distinguish agent-as-self from agent-on-behalf-of-user.
findings.recommendation: Implement JWT-based auth with dual claims for identity propagation.

compensating_controls: Implement JWT with agent/user dual claims
Use X-On-Behalf-Of headers with validation

findings.title: Plaintext Credentials in Configuration
findings.description: Database credentials stored in plaintext in web.config (Password=Time2006!). No secrets management or rotation.
findings.gap: Hardcoded credentials with no rotation. Exposable via prompt injection or agent bug.
findings.recommendation: Migrate credentials to AWS Secrets Manager with automatic rotation.

compensating_controls: Migrate to AWS Secrets Manager with rotation
Encrypt connectionStrings section as interim

findings.title: No Audit Logging
findings.description: No logging infrastructure. No audit trail for write operations. No CloudTrail, no application-level logging.
findings.gap: Zero audit logging. Cannot attribute or trace any operation.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured audit logging for all write operations with immutable storage.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND zero audit logging exists.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Write-enabled agents require full audit attribution. No logging infrastructure means agent actions are completely undetectable and non-forensic.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Implement structured audit logging for all write operations.
blocker_remediation.target_state: Every write operation logged with principal attribution in tamper-evident storage.

findings.title: No Agent Identity Suspension Mechanism
findings.description: No mechanism to suspend individual identities. Forms auth with InProc session. Only option is IIS app pool restart affecting all users.
findings.gap: Cannot isolate misbehaving agent without disrupting all users.
findings.recommendation: Implement per-agent identity lifecycle with immediate revocation capability.

compensating_controls: Implement per-agent API key with revocation endpoint
Use identity provider with user-level disable

findings.title: No Compensation or Rollback Mechanism
findings.description: Raw INSERT with no transaction management, no compensation logic, no rollback capability, no error handling.
findings.gap: Failed multi-step agent workflows leave database in partial state with no recovery.
findings.recommendation: Wrap writes in transactions. Implement compensation endpoints for reversing operations.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no compensation or rollback mechanism exists.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Write-enabled agents executing multi-step workflows leave database in irrecoverable partial state on failure.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Wrap write operations in database transactions with error handling.
blocker_remediation.target_state: All multi-step operations are transactional with compensation endpoints.

findings.title: State Only Queryable via UI
findings.description: BindGrid queries database state but it is only accessible via WebForms UI rendering, not a programmatic API.
findings.gap: Current state not queryable via machine-readable API.
findings.recommendation: Expose GET /timesheets endpoint returning JSON.

findings.title: No Concurrency Controls
findings.description: No optimistic locking, version fields, ETags, or conditional writes. Concurrent agent instances can corrupt state.
findings.gap: No protection against race conditions from concurrent agent instances.
findings.recommendation: Implement optimistic locking with version fields and conditional writes.

compensating_controls: Add version column with optimistic locking
Implement unique constraints preventing duplicate concurrent inserts

findings.title: No Rate Limiting
findings.description: No rate limiting at any layer. Direct IIS deployment with no API gateway, WAF, or throttling middleware.
findings.gap: No protection against runaway agent loops.
findings.recommendation: Deploy API Gateway with throttling and usage plans.

compensating_controls: Deploy API Gateway with usage plans and throttling
Implement IIS request filtering as interim

findings.title: No Transaction Limits or Blast Radius Caps
findings.description: No transaction limits. Agent could insert unlimited entries without per-session or per-operation caps.
findings.gap: Blast radius of agent error is unbounded.
findings.recommendation: Implement per-agent business transaction limits (max_entries_per_hour).

compensating_controls: Implement per-caller transaction limits
Add batch operation size caps

findings.title: No Draft/Pending State
findings.description: All writes immediately committed. INSERT executes directly with no intermediate review state.
findings.gap: No mechanism for agent to propose changes for human review before committing.
findings.recommendation: Add status column with DRAFT/PENDING/APPROVED states.

compensating_controls: Add status column (DRAFT/PENDING/APPROVED)
Implement two-step API: create then confirm

findings.title: No Configurable Approval Gates
findings.description: No approval workflow. All operations execute immediately without human confirmation option.
findings.gap: Cannot configure operations to require human approval.
findings.recommendation: Implement configurable approval gates for high-risk operations.

compensating_controls: Implement operation-type-based approval flags
Use external workflow orchestration with human approval tasks

findings.title: No Sandbox/Staging Environment
findings.description: No sandbox or staging. Single hardcoded database connection. First agent testing would occur against production.
findings.gap: No safe environment for agent testing.
findings.recommendation: Create staging environment with production-equivalent data shape.

findings.title: Sensitive Employee Data Unscoped in Responses
findings.description: Stage A: System stores employee PII (employee_id, work hours, project assignments). Stage B: B1 fires — all columns returned without scoping. B2 fires — single db user, no access differentiation.
findings.gap: B1: No field-level scoping on data returned. B2: No access control differentiation. B3: No classification metadata.
findings.recommendation: Implement response DTOs excluding sensitive fields. Create differentiated access roles.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND B1 sub-check fired (sensitive fields unscoped in responses).
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: DATA-Q1 B1 fired because BindGrid returns all database columns including employee_id without field-level scoping. B2 additionally fired: single ts_app database user with no access differentiation.

b1.reasoning: All columns returned in BindGrid query. No field exclusion or separate DTOs.

b2.reasoning: Single database user ts_app with full access. No role differentiation.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Implement response DTOs with field-level scoping.
blocker_remediation.target_state: Agent-facing APIs return only non-sensitive fields. Sensitive data via separately-authorized endpoints.

findings.title: No Data Residency Controls
findings.description: Employee PII stored in SQL Server (10.0.6.15) with no residency controls, jurisdiction documentation, or sovereignty enforcement.
findings.gap: No controls preventing agent from transmitting employee PII to LLM in different jurisdiction.
findings.recommendation: Document residency requirements. Configure region-local LLM endpoints.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND employee PII has no residency controls.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Employee timesheet data includes PII (employee identifiers, work patterns). No residency configuration prevents an agent from sending this data to an LLM provider in another jurisdiction.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Document data residency requirements for employee data.
blocker_remediation.target_state: Residency documented, PII classified, technical controls for jurisdiction enforcement.

findings.title: No Pagination or Result Limits
findings.description: BindGrid returns all rows for employee with no pagination, filtering, or size limits.
findings.gap: Unbounded result sets exhaust LLM context windows.
findings.recommendation: Implement cursor-based pagination with configurable page size.

findings.title: SQL Injection — Zero Input Validation
findings.description: Zero input validation. String concatenation SQL creates critical SQL injection vulnerability. Accepts any malformed input.
findings.gap: No parameterized queries, no type checking, no validation, no structured error responses.
findings.recommendation: Immediately convert to parameterized queries. Implement input validation with structured field-level errors.

findings.title: No System Timestamps or Freshness Signaling
findings.description: Only user-entered entry_date. No created_at, updated_at, or freshness headers.
findings.gap: Cannot determine record creation/modification time or data freshness.
findings.recommendation: Add system-managed temporal columns (created_at, updated_at) with UTC timestamps.

findings.title: PII Exposed in Error Messages
findings.description: customErrors mode='Off' exposes SQL queries containing employee_id in stack traces. No PII masking infrastructure.
findings.gap: PII exposed in error messages. Employee identifiers visible in error output.
findings.recommendation: Set customErrors mode='On'. Implement error handling that masks PII.

compensating_controls: Set customErrors mode='RemoteOnly' or 'On'
Implement structured error handling excluding raw SQL

findings.title: No Data Quality Monitoring
findings.description: No data quality metrics, completeness monitoring, or quality scores.
findings.gap: No quality signal for agent consumers.
findings.recommendation: Implement basic data quality monitoring once system is modernized.

findings.title: No Schema Versioning or API Contracts
findings.description: No schema versioning, no API contracts, no migration files, no breaking change detection.
findings.gap: Schema changes silently break agent tool bindings.
findings.recommendation: Implement schema versioning and contract testing in CI.

findings.title: No Data Catalog or Metadata Layer
findings.description: No data catalog, metadata layer, or data dictionary documentation.
findings.gap: No semantic layer to accelerate agent tool definition.
findings.recommendation: Create data dictionary documenting timesheets table schema.

findings.title: No Tracing or Structured Logging
findings.description: No OpenTelemetry, X-Ray, trace IDs, JSON logs, or correlation IDs. Zero observability.
findings.gap: Cannot trace or debug agent-initiated requests.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured JSON logging with correlation IDs and OpenTelemetry.

findings.title: No Alerting Infrastructure
findings.description: No alerting. No CloudWatch alarms, no anomaly detection, no monitoring.
findings.gap: Cannot detect system degradation impacting agents.
findings.recommendation: Implement CloudWatch alarms for error rates and latency.

findings.title: No Infrastructure as Code
findings.description: No IaC. Manual VS publish to network share on IIS 6/Windows Server 2003.
findings.gap: Infrastructure not defined as code, no peer review, no drift detection.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to IaC (Terraform or CDK) with peer review and drift detection.

findings.title: No CI/CD Pipeline
findings.description: No CI/CD. Manual Visual Studio publish. No automated testing or contract testing.
findings.gap: No pipeline to catch breaking changes before agents are affected.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD with API contract testing.

findings.title: No Rollback Capability
findings.description: Manual file copy deployment. No blue/green, no canary, no feature flags, no version tagging.
findings.gap: Cannot roll back broken deployments.
findings.recommendation: Implement automated deployment with rollback capability.

findings.title: Zero Test Coverage
findings.description: No tests exist. No unit tests, integration tests, or API tests.
findings.gap: No automated verification of API behavior.
findings.recommendation: Implement automated API tests covering core paths.

findings.title: No Encryption at Rest
findings.description: No encryption-at-rest config. SQL Server 2005 on Windows Server 2003 with no TDE or KMS.
findings.gap: Employee data stored unencrypted.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to RDS with KMS-encrypted storage.

evaluations.title: Asynchronous Operation Support
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no evidence of long-running operations (>30s) in this stateful-crud service.

evaluations.title: Circuit Breakers and Resilience
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — service does not call other services or external APIs beyond its own database.

evaluations.title: Graceful Degradation Signaling
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no P0 priority designation and no evidence of critical-path role.

evaluations.title: Semantically Meaningful Field Names
evaluations.reason: Field names (employee_id, entry_date, hours, project) are semantically meaningful and human-readable. No legacy abbreviations.

evaluations.title: Business Outcome Metrics
evaluations.reason: System emits no metrics or telemetry of any kind — no observability surface to assess. Informational signal suppressed.

items.summary: Resolve all 7 BLOCKERs and critical RISK-SAFETY findings. Build API layer, implement machine identity, audit logging, compensation logic, data scoping, and residency controls. Fix SQL injection and PII exposure immediately.
Address remaining RISK-SAFETY and RISK-QUALITY findings. Implement identity propagation, approval gates, observability, IaC, CI/CD, and schema versioning.
Address INFO items and remaining quality improvements. Add event emission, rate limit headers, data quality monitoring, data catalog, and test coverage.

recommended_actions.action: Build REST API layer replacing WebForms UI
recommended_actions.rationale: No programmatic API exists. This is the foundational blocker — all other remediations depend on having a callable API surface.

recommended_actions.action: Implement machine identity and authorization framework
recommended_actions.rationale: Identity is required before any other security control can function. Without machine identity, agents cannot authenticate.
Plaintext credentials in web.config are an immediate security risk. Quick win with high security impact.
Zero audit trail means agent actions are undetectable. Required for compliance and forensics.

recommended_actions.action: Fix SQL injection and implement input validation
recommended_actions.rationale: Critical security vulnerability. Agents sending malformed input could compromise the database.

recommended_actions.action: Implement data classification and residency controls
recommended_actions.rationale: Employee PII unscoped and without residency controls creates regulatory and compliance exposure.
